question: Was the programme usable, relevant and feasible?
measure_examples: Relevance/acceptability ratings, attendance, completion, task submission, burden, interviews
can_establish: How participants experienced delivery and whether the planned programme was delivered or completed
cannot_establish_alone: Learning, changed behaviour, improved follower outcomes

question: What did participants learn or become able to do?
measure_examples: Knowledge tests, scored cases, observed simulations; keep confidence/self-rated knowledge separate
raters: Tests or trained assessors, with participant self-reports identified as such
timing: Before training, after training, and retention assessment where relevant
can_establish: Change on the particular task or measure
cannot_establish_alone: Transfer to an actual workplace or durable impact

question: Did leadership behaviour change at work?
measure_examples: Behaviourally specific employee/peer/supervisor ratings, structured observations, work samples or logs
raters: People exposed to the behaviour and independent observers where feasible
timing: A genuine pretraining baseline and follow-up after opportunities to apply the skills
can_establish: Observed or perceived behaviour at stated times and contexts
cannot_establish_alone: Training caused the change; a generic 360-degree rating is not automatically a validated or unbiased measure

question: Did followers or teams benefit?
construct: Relationships, shared identity, team functioning and well-being
measure_examples: Follower-reported support, team psychological safety, identification, coordination, stress or engagement
raters: Team members where the claim concerns team experience; leader-only ratings remain leader perceptions
timing: Baseline and repeated follow-up with stable or documented team membership
can_establish: The measured experiences or functioning of the sampled followers/teams
cannot_establish_alone: Objective performance, universal benefit or causation

question: Did the programme improve outcomes that matter in this setting?
construct: Service, educational, organizational or clinical outcomes
measure_examples: Student achievement, retention, service quality, errors, patient-care processes, costs
raters: Administrative records, independent observation or explicitly identified subjective reports
timing: Enough follow-up for the proposed mechanism, with relevant baseline or comparison data
can_establish: Changes or differences in the particular outcome
cannot_establish_alone: Attribution to training: objective data can still be confounded

question: Did change last, and were there costs or unintended consequences?
measure_examples: Repeated outcome measurements, staff turnover, workload, adverse experiences, implementation costs
raters: Participants, followers and records, chosen for the specific consequence
timing: Prespecified follow-up and ongoing adverse-event/burden collection
can_establish: Durability and the observed tradeoffs within the follow-up window
cannot_establish_alone: No harm when harms were not assessed, or return on investment without both costs and attributable benefits
